method: Bounded NRV2B-LE32 decompression and actual stub branch filter; structural recognition does not depend on section names or a UPX header.
isolated_reference: Unicorn executes only the decompressor/branch restoration range 0x1003076b..0x1003086e; OS/import resolution is never executed.
comparison: Cargo test with NRV_EXTERNAL_SAMPLE and NRV_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE passed exact byte equality.
bounds: 64 MiB input/output limits; work bounds, checked PE extents, checked backward references, no OS or network execution.
limitations: Memory-layout representation for analysis; not a pristine runnable PE and imports are not rebuilt.

other_recovery.method: Bounded isolated table initializer, pure byte-table transform and zlib; managed trampoline loads second protected resource.
other_recovery.remaining: Inner virtualized .NET payload still protected; no automatic Reactor extractor added.
